title: Create 'log-keeper' Terraform module for CloudTrail shipping, OpenSearch ILM, and active health checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a reusable Terraform module named 'log-keeper' to standardize CloudTrail -> S3 -> OpenSearch log shipping inside Private/VPC deployments, attach environment-scoped ILM (index lifecycle management) and retention policies, and provide an automated health-checking surface for alerting and remediation. Scope includes: module API, cross-account S3 access patterns, index naming and rollover, ILM templates, lifecycle to S3 cold/archive (Glacier-compatible), a small healthcheck lambda with synthetic verification of ingestion and ILM state, unit/integration test harness, and upgrade migration guidance for existing stacks. This ticket captures design decisions, implementation steps, testing, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module 'log-keeper' publishes with semantic versioning in private registry
Module variables cover: environment, retention_days, cold_archive_days, index_prefix, opensearch_domain_id, s3_bucket_arn, cross_account_role_arn, kms_key_id
Default ILM policy created and applied with rollover at 50GB or 7d (configurable), cold phase to S3 after cold_archive_days, delete after retention_days
Healthcheck lambda runs in customer VPC (or VPC-less option) and verifies: CloudTrail file landing in S3, ingestion into OpenSearch index, ILM policy attachment and current index phase
Module outputs: opensearch_index_pattern, ilm_policy_id, s3_bucket_name, cloudtrail_sink_role
Automated test harness with Terraform acceptance tests that can run in CI using pre-provisioned test account
Backward-compatible upgrade guide for prior logging modules and a migration plan for stateful resources
Runbook and Grafana/Console dashboards links included in module README
implementation_notes: Expose variables to allow per-customer retention tuning while providing sane defaults for dev/staging/prod
Use tf 'aws_s3_bucket' with server-side encryption (KMS) and block public access; enforce object lock not required but lifecycle transitions to Glacier configured
Create CloudTrail Trail resource that writes to provided S3 bucket or accept an existing bucket ARN; avoid forcing creation when customers already manage Trails
Provide optional cross-account role creation for central logging accounts (assume-role pattern) and clear docs for trust policy
Opensearch ILM: create template that uses time-based index suffix and rollover alias; avoid hard-coding index sizes—document trade-offs between size and age

Healthcheck: lightweight Lambda (python) that triggers every 5m — performs three checks (S3 object listing for recent CloudTrail file, OpenSearch _cat/indices for recent index and docs, ILM explain for primary write alias). Lambda reports to CloudWatch metrics and creates PagerDuty/Slack alert on failure threshold
To minimize blast radius, module supports "canary_index" boolean flag which, when true, will create canary index and synthetic events to validate pipeline
State management: where possible, make resources create_before_destroy false for critical resources; provide migration helper script for reindexing if alias names change
Testing: include terratest-compatible examples and a small in-repo harness that validates ILM transitions
testing_plan: Unit: static terraform fmt/validate and check for required variables and naming conventions
Integration: run module against a pre-provisioned AWS test account (sandbox-logs) to validate S3 Bucket, CloudTrail sink, OpenSearch templates, ILM creation, and healthcheck lambda execution
Chaos: simulate delayed ingestion by throttling ingest pipeline and ensure healthcheck detects and alerts
Upgrade test: simulate existing index with old naming and run migration helper to re-alias and reapply ILM; verify no data loss
Security: run KMS and bucket policy static analysis; ensure least-privilege IAM for healthcheck Lambda
rollout_plan: Publish v0.1.0 to private terraform registry and tag repo
Onboard two internal customers (staging and analytics platform) as pilot adopters using module in canary mode
Monitor healthcheck metrics for 72h; iterate on defaults and IAM scopes
After pilot, release v1.0.0 with documented upgrade path and runbook
Announce module and provide migration office hours with Solutions Engineering for first 30 customers
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Incorrect IAM cross-account trust could block ingestion — Mitigation: provide templated trust policy and automated policy validator in CI
Risk: ILM misconfiguration leading to premature deletion — Mitigation: require explicit retention_days; add safeguard and dry-run tool for deletion phase

Risk: Healthcheck Lambda in VPC causes ENI cold-start issues — Mitigation: provide VPC-less option that uses signed API calls from monitoring account or run healthchecks from centralized polling service
Risk: State migration complexity for existing indices — Mitigation: provide helper script, document reindexing costs and fallback to export/import via S3
Risk: Large customers with high ingestion rates may need custom sizing — Mitigation: doc guidance and knob for rollover thresholds and shard allocation settings
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created. Draft API for the module variables attached to Confluence. Calling out need for security review due to cross-account roles.

2026-03-11 Liam O'Connor: Spike complete — validated approach for ILM -> S3 cold phase using OpenSearch snapshots vs ILM S3 lifecycle. Chosen approach: ILM with searchable rollover + lifecycle to S3 via repository snapshot for deep archive. Note: snapshot to S3 requires repository and snapshot lifecycle; added as an optional submodule.
2026-03-12 Security: Reviewed IAM templates; requested tighter KMS grants for cross-account role and a condition restricting source VPC. Updated trust policy template and flagged for final review.

2026-03-13 QA: Added integration test matrix items. Healthcheck lambda prototype passes S3 and OpenSearch checks in staging. Observed intermittent 504 on OpenSearch domain when running heavy index creation; added backoff/retry in lambda and a CI step to throttle index create rate.
